metadata.name: GetMerchantTransactionLog
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to get merchant transaction log.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant ID assigned to merchant. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: StoreNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number which is assgined to a Store. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: RegisterNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number which is assigned to a register. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: FromDate
request_fields.description: Starting date of transaction search. Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020 Condition: Default value should be 1 month before date from current date

request_fields.name: ToDate
request_fields.description: End date of transaction search. Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020 Condition: Default value should be 1 day before date from current date

request_fields.name: TransactionDateTime
request_fields.description: Date and Time transaction when occurred Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 12:10:01

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for the  transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789

request_fields.name: PostDateTime
request_fields.description: This is the time when transaction actually got posted in system. Valid Values: valid date Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 12:10:01

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ApplicationNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application . Valid Values:0-9 Example:8002201421 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name of account holder Valid Values:a-z Format:XXXX Example:John Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last name of account holder Valid Values:a-z Format:XXXX Example:Smith Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: TransactionType
request_fields.description: Type of Transaction (Purchase debit,payment reversal etc) Valid Values: 23 - DIRECTED PAYMENT 3 - INTEREST CREDIT 2 - INTEREST DEBIT 21 - NON-DIRECTED PAYMENT 28 - NON-DIRECTED PAYMENT REVERSAL 22 - PAYMENT REVERSAL 49 - PRINCIPAL CREDIT 48 - PRINCIPAL DEBIT 40 - PURCHASE DEBIT 43 - PURCHASE DEBIT REVERSAL 41 - PURCHASE RETURN 42 - PURCHASE RETURN REVERSAL 29 - REVERSAL OF NON-DIRECTED PAYMENT REVERSAL Format: XX Example: 41 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CreditPlanMaster
request_fields.description: Plan name associated with the card account. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full

request_fields.name: Amount
request_fields.description: Amount for which transaction occurred Valid Values:  0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $20.00

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch Default Value would be 50. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page Default value would be 0 Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
